SourceProxy.name: SHYXEMeshReader
SourceProxy.label: SHYX OpenFOAM eMesh Reader

Documentation.long_help: Reads ASCII OpenFOAM featureEdgeMesh (.eMesh) and extendedFeatureEdgeMesh files as vtkPolyData lines. Gzip and binary Foam format are not supported. Classified extended files get the same EdgeStatus / PointStatus / FoamExtendedFeatureEdgeMesh arrays as SHYX Extended Feature Edge Mesh, so the output can be connected to SHYX SnappyHexMesh Feature edges. File → Open also lists this reader for .eMesh.

SourceProxy.Documentation: Reads OpenFOAM feature-edge ASCII files used by snappyHexMesh (surfaceFeatureExtract / surfaceFeatures output). Simple featureEdgeMesh files become unlabelled lines. Extended files keep OpenFOAM edge/point classification and the original FoamFile blob.

StringVectorProperty.name: FileName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Path to an OpenFOAM .eMesh or .extendedFeatureEdgeMesh file.
